page.overview:
Who is Bart Simpson's Day Off?

Bart Simpson's Day Off is a Bart Simpson story first printed in Bart Simpson #5.

Milhouse is waiting at the school bus stop, expecting another dull day, when suddenly Bart yanks him into a bush and asks him to choose - school or fun? Milhouse chooses to skip school, even though today is the Springfield Tournament of Posies parade.

Later on, the boys are sitting bored outside of the Kwik-E-Mart. They have a Squishee race to see who can drink theirs the fastest, which leaves Milhouse with brain freeze and Bart the winner. Suddenly, the terrifying Leopold appears. The boys hide, but Apu informs him that they're outside. They run away as Leopold chases them, and they hide in a vintage clothing store.

Bart and Milhouse emerge from the store dressed as Sonny and Cher respectively, and Leopold storms off. Only after colliding with Barney does Leopold come to his senses and realizes that the boys are in disguise. He chases them again.
